transcript: Speaker A (AI): Foreigner se fuse hona? [Confused by a foreigner?] Speaker B (Human): Haan, ek gora tapri pe aaya, uski farratedar English sunkar main ghabra gaya. [Yes, a foreigner came to the tea stall, and I got nervous hearing his fluent English.] Speaker A (AI): Ghabrana chhodo, Speak Easy app pe aao. Main AI tutor hoon, mere sath akele practice karo. [Stop worrying, use the Speak Easy app. I'm an AI tutor, practice alone with me.] Speaker B (Human): Idea accha hai, par kya AI meri tootifooti English samajh payega? [Good idea, but can AI understand my broken English?] Speaker A (AI): Ekdam! Main Hindi mein bhi baat karti hoon, aur bina mazak udaaye galti theek karti hoon. [Absolutely! I also speak Hindi and correct mistakes without making fun of you.] Speaker B (Human): Sahi hai, phir toh agli baar main gore se confidently baat karunga. [Great, then next time I'll speak confidently with the foreigner.] Speaker A (AI): Apna confidence dikhao, aaj hi Speak Easy app download karo. [Show your confidence, download the Speak Easy app today.] Speaker B (Human): Bilkul, apni tapri ka swag badhane ke liye main abhi install karta hoon. [Absolutely, I'll install it now to boost my tea stall's swag.] Speaker C (Human): Abhi Speak Easy app download karein, aur farratedar English bolna shuru karein. [Download the Speak Easy app now and start speaking fluent English.]
